settings.heading: About the course,
settings.text:
I spent nine years at a bank, talking to people about loans and savings. The ones who were doing well rarely earned the most. They had a simple plan, and they looked at it.

So this course is not another app to download. Knowing where it goes, a plan you keep and saving first matter far more than any tool, and a spreadsheet you understand beats one you do not.

Four weeks, twenty minutes a day. You will know where every pound, euro or dollar went by the end of the first week.
settings.name: Nina Hart
settings.role: Money teacher, nine years in banking. Write your own letter here.
settings.image_alt: A woman typing at a wooden table by a bright window

settings.heading: Four weeks,
settings.text: Every week builds on the one before. Do them in order, at your own pace.

settings.label: Week 1
settings.title: Where it goes
settings.text: Track a month of spending without a spreadsheet habit you will drop.
settings.lessons:
Your money in one place
What a month really costs
Fixed, flexible and forgotten
Subscriptions you do not use
Your first honest number
Task: log every spend for seven days

settings.label: Week 2
settings.title: A plan you keep
settings.text: Build a budget around the bills you already have, not the ones you wish you had.
settings.lessons:
Pay yourself first
Three pots, not thirty categories
A budget for irregular costs
Couples and shared bills
When the month goes wrong
Task: your first full budget

settings.label: Week 3
settings.title: Debt and a cushion
settings.text: Pay down what costs you most and build a buffer for the surprises.
settings.lessons:
What your debt really costs
Which one to pay first
An emergency fund that fits
Talking to your bank
Credit scores, plainly
Task: your payoff plan

settings.label: Week 4
settings.title: Saving and investing
settings.text: Make saving automatic and learn how index funds and pensions work.
settings.lessons:
Saving on autopilot
Pensions and workplace schemes
Index funds, plainly
Fees that eat returns
A plan for the next year
Task: set up one automatic transfer

settings.promise_title: Watch the first week, then decide
settings.promise_text: If the course is not for you, write within 30 days and you get every cent back. No form to fill in.
settings.heading: Your first real budget is
settings.text: Twenty four lessons, four live calls, the budget spreadsheet and the workbook.
